Groundwater and drought bulletin: March 2025

Groundwater recharge across the monitored basins declined for the third consecutive year, according to the national monitoring network, and officials warned that supply interruptions could spread to additional municipalities during the coming dry season unless abstraction limits are enforced.

Household survey

# of households without piped water: 1,240 in 2024, up from 860 in 2020.

The survey covered 18 districts. Status: Emergency(provisional) declared in 14 districts. Confirmed cases (*) and suspected cases (**) of water-borne disease are reported separately.

Energy and emissions

Pumping raised CO2 emissions 5%1 over an irrigated area of 4.2 km2, and about 106 m3 of water was lifted each day. The programme cost US$2.3bn and cut losses 10x faster than planned.

Results for 31 aquifers

Recovery was incomplete in 31 of 42 aquifers after the most recent drought, and median storage loss reached 0.41 metres per year in aquifers with repeated droughts.

1. Relative to the 2019–2023 average.
